name: Hammersbacher Hütt'n
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hammersbacher Hütt'n in Grainau!** Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy mountain hut offers breathtaking views of the **Zugspitze**, Germany’s highest peak. Whether you’re craving hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Käseknödel**, or a steaming bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**, our rustic charm and warm hospitality will make your alpine escape unforgettable. After a satisfying meal, warm up by the crackling fireplace or take a stroll through the snow-covered trails right outside. For adventurers, guided hikes, snowshoeing, and winter wonderland experiences await—all with a stunning backdrop of the **Karwendel** and **Mieminger** mountains.
